# Model-Pilot

> ModelPilot answers one question: given this software task, what is the cheapest AI configuration likely to complete it reliably? It scores a task on 8 dimensions (complexity, ambiguity, consequence, novelty, context demand, scope, tool demand, verifiability) and recommends a model, a reasoning effort level and an execution strategy. Live at https://model-pilot-ten.vercel.app/. Next.js, TypeScript.
